description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class 'LogFragment' that contains and manages a custom log view ('LogView'). It provides methods to initialize the UI components, handle text changes, and expose the LogView instance. The class is part of an example Android project for logging and debugging purposes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view ('LogView') inside a scrollable view. It inflates and configures the UI components, handles text change events to auto-scroll, and provides access to the LogView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes the ScrollView and LogView, sets their layout parameters, styling, and padding; returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher on LogView for auto-scrolling, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the instance of the LogView contained in this fragment.
